title: Proof Plan for Converse Exhaustion
body_html:
Proof Plan for Converse Exhaustion

  1. Use the depth-preservation building sum to choose \(x''\) and \(w\) supporting the given refined source \(K\)-type.
  2. Use the source character to force \(M(w)\) into the semisimple coset of the source datum.
  3. Use Kim-Murnaghan conjugacy to make the leading top-depth moment value block diagonal.
  4. Split \(V'\), \(w\), and the target lattice function into top and lower blocks.
  5. Perturb the top block by moment-map surjectivity so that \(M(bw)=b\Gamma\).
  6. Apply the induction hypothesis to the lower block.
  7. Reassemble the target datum as the direct sum of the single positive-depth top lift and the inductively obtained lower lift.
  8. Compare splittings to show the new source datum is equivalent to the original covering datum.
